coverage.scope: Migration prepare/step/finalize only; setup, observations and connection cleanup excluded.

limits: Agreement totals count executed instances, not distinct programs or complete requirement satisfaction.
All currently query-blocked agreeing prefixes are empty; no DDL progress is credited to them.
Same-file reopen is fixed, but TEMP/ATTACH, callbacks, nondefault open/configuration contexts and nondeterministic functions remain excluded.
Runtime-generated Tcl data may vary between extractions; frozen captured SQL and native observations are replayed exactly.
Corpus growth and migration-only coverage denominators are not comparable to the earlier headline totals.
Live coverage was measured on aarch64-darwin; Linux coverage remains for CI.
